For the most recent event, see 2024 Summer Olympics.
The inaugural Games took place in 1896 in Athens, then part of the Kingdom of Greece, and the most recent was held in 2024 in Paris, France.
London and Paris have hosted three times, while Los Angeles, Athens, and Tokyo have each hosted twice; Los Angeles will host the Games for the third time in 2028.
Paris hosted for the third time in 2024, while Los Angeles will do so in 2028.
